messages.content:
You implemented the Phase 1 Foundation & Scaffold; two GLM reviews found a small set of items. Apply these fixes to the EXISTING code (your prior context + worktree are loaded). Keep strict TypeScript. Do NOT change the public asset-manifest KEYS or DIMENSIONS — they are the LOCKED Phase-2 contract; only change how assets are USED/wired. Re-verify `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` BOTH pass before finishing.

FIXES:
1. [MAJOR — real latent defect] iOS/mobile audio-unlock is dead. `AudioManager.unlockOnFirstPointer(scene)` binds `scene.input.once('pointerdown')` on PreloadScene, which shuts down immediately after `scene.start(Menu)` — Phaser's InputPlugin.shutdown() removes the listener before any user tap, so WebAudio never resumes on the real first gesture. Re-wire to a LONG-LIVED emitter: attach a one-time `window`/`document` 'pointerdown' (and/or 'touchend') listener ONCE (e.g. from BootScene.create() or main.ts) that calls the idempotent resume() and then removes itself. It must survive scene transitions so the real first gesture unlocks audio. (No Phase-1 audio yet, but this must be correct for later phases.)
2. [minor] Manifest honesty / zero-code-swap: `ui_progress_bar` (1180×14) and `ui_score_icon` (44×44) are LOADED but never displayed (the HUD draws the bar from primitives and the score as text). Wire them in so every manifest key is a real in-use asset: show `ui_score_icon` beside the score, and render the progress-bar FRAME from the `ui_progress_bar` image with the dynamic fill drawn/scaled over it. Do NOT remove the keys.
3. [minor] Placeholder generator single-source: `scripts/gen-placeholders.mjs` keeps its own duplicate 34-entry ASSETS array that must stay in lock-step with `src/config/assetManifest.ts`, with nothing enforcing it (a new manifest key would silently 404 at load). Make `assetManifest.ts` the SINGLE source of truth for the generator (lightest robust mechanism — e.g. add `tsx` as a devDep and import the manifest, or export a plain data list the .mjs can import). If a full single-source is disproportionate, at minimum add a loud fail-fast guard (build- or run-time) on any manifest↔asset-file mismatch. Keep the 34 generated greybox SVGs identical.
4. [nit] `src/scenes/GameScene.ts` — the scene-wide `input.on('pointerdown')` jump handler also fires when tapping the temporary Win/Lose debug buttons. Scope the jump input so tapping those debug buttons doesn't also trigger a hop.
5. [nit] `src/scenes/ResultsScene.ts:create(data)` — add a safe default/guard for missing/partial FinishGameParams (default to a lose/Game-Over result) so the scene is robust if entered without data.
6. [nit] `src/scenes/MenuScene.ts` — `menu_title` text is drawn on top of the `ui_title_logo` image at the same position. Remove the duplicate text title (or offset it) so the placeholder doesn't overlap.
7. [nit] `src/config/gameConfig.ts` — correct the LEVEL_LENGTH comment arithmetic (the 400→700 px/s ramp mean is ~550 px/s → ~73 s, not ~520/~75).
8. [nit] `vite.config.ts` — raise `build.chunkSizeWarningLimit` so the production build emits no >500 kB advisory (the chunk is Phaser itself). Do NOT add manualChunks/code-splitting.

OUT OF SCOPE — do NOT implement (deferred to later phases): extracting ui/Hud.ts + PauseOverlay, wiring the pause loop, adding audio assets or an 'audio' loader branch, and parallax-tiling art changes. The `track.ts` `object` impl-signature is deliberate and correct — leave it.

FINAL OUTPUT: list each file you changed and the fix applied; confirm `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` BOTH still PASS; and explicitly confirm the asset-manifest KEYS and DIMENSIONS are UNCHANGED (or, if you were forced to change any, list exactly what and why).

outputs.summary:
Applied all 8 GLM-review fixes to the existing Phase-1 code. Strict TypeScript preserved. Asset-manifest KEYS and DIMENSIONS are UNCHANGED — assetManifest.ts was not edited at all; only how assets are USED/wired changed. Both verifications PASS.

VERIFICATION (both required, both PASS):
- `npx tsc --noEmit` → PASS (0 errors, full strict-family flags).
- `npm run build` (vite) → PASS, 23 modules → dist/. The >500 kB chunk advisory is now GONE (chunk 1496 kB < new 2000 kB limit); no warnings emitted.
- `npm run gen:placeholders` (now via tsx, single-sourced from the manifest) regenerated all 34 SVGs BYTE-IDENTICAL (verified with sha256sum -c against a pre-change snapshot: "ALL 34 SVGs BYTE-IDENTICAL"). Manifest = 34 keys = 34 SVGs still aligned.

ASSET-MANIFEST CONTRACT: KEYS + DIMENSIONS UNCHANGED. `git status` confirms src/config/assetManifest.ts was not modified. No key renamed, no width/height changed. The two previously-unused keys are now genuinely in use (fix #2).

FILES CHANGED + FIX APPLIED:
1) src/systems/AudioManager.ts — [MAJOR fix] Replaced the dead `unlockOnFirstPointer(scene)` (bound to PreloadScene.input.once → removed by InputPlugin.shutdown before any tap) with `installAudioUnlock(sound)`: a ONE-TIME, idempotent (`unlockInstalled` guard) listener on `window` for both 'pointerdown' and 'touchend' that resumes a suspended WebAudio context on the real first gesture, then removes both listeners. Survives all scene transitions.
   src/scenes/BootScene.ts — calls `AudioManager.installAudioUnlock(this.sound)` in create() (long-lived, before any teardown).
   src/scenes/PreloadScene.ts — removed the dead unlock call + now-unused AudioManager import; ALSO added a loud `FILE_LOAD_ERROR` handler (console.error naming the key+src) as a real-error fail-loud guard so a missing SVG can't 404 silently.
2) src/scenes/GameScene.ts — [minor] buildHud() now displays `ui_score_icon` (44×44) at (38,58) next to the score text, and renders the progress-bar FRAME from the `ui_progress_bar` image (1180×14) with the dynamic fill rectangle scaled underneath it (fill logic unchanged; Phase-2 art swaps in against the same key/size). Every manifest key is now a real in-use asset.
3) scripts/gen-placeholders.mts (NEW, replaces .mjs) + package.json — [minor] gen:placeholders now runs via `tsx` and imports ASSET_MANIFEST directly from src/config/assetManifest.ts (folder derived from each entry's `path`), so the generator has NO duplicate 34-entry array — the manifest is the single source of truth. Added `tsx ^4.19.0` devDep (npm install: +4 packages, 0 vulnerabilities). Old scripts/gen-placeholders.mjs deleted. Output byte-identical (proven above). README updated to reflect .mts + single-sourcing.
4) src/scenes/GameScene.ts — [nit] Replaced the scene-wide `input.on('pointerdown')` jump (which also fired when tapping the debug Win/Lose buttons) with an interactive full-screen `zone` created BEFORE the debug buttons; with Phaser's default `input.topOnly`, a tap on a debug button hits only the button, never also the hop. Keyboard SPACE jump retained.
5) src/scenes/ResultsScene.ts — [nit] `create()` signature is now `data: Partial<FinishGameParams> = {}` with safe defaults: missing/invalid `result` → lose (Game-Over), non-number `score` → 0. Robust if entered without data (deep-link / hot reload).
6) src/scenes/MenuScene.ts — [nit] Removed the duplicate `menu_title` text that was drawn on top of the `ui_title_logo` image at the same (cx,180) position; the logo placeholder no longer overlaps. `menu_title` remains a reserved i18n string (document/share title).
7) src/config/gameConfig.ts — [nit] Corrected the LEVEL_LENGTH comment: 40000 / (400→700 ramp mean ~550 px/s) ≈ 73 s (was mislabeled ~520 px/s → ~75 s).
8) vite.config.ts — [nit] Added `build.chunkSizeWarningLimit: 2000` so the Phaser-sized chunk no longer trips the >500 kB advisory. No manualChunks/code-splitting added (per constraint).

OUT-OF-SCOPE ITEMS respected (not implemented): no ui/Hud.ts / PauseOverlay extraction, no pause loop, no audio assets or 'audio' loader branch, no parallax-tiling art changes. track.ts `object` impl-signature left exactly as-is (deliberate/correct).

Scene flow remains navigable: Boot→Preload→Menu→Game→Results→(Play Again→Game | Menu link→Menu). Analytics still fire at the 3 correct transitions.
